Name: bUsed
Comment: Feed wired for native tracking (PRG call)

Name: iDir
Comment: Belt travel sign (+1 / -1) from the feed config

Name: rOrgX
Comment: Belt CS origin X in world/MCS [mm] (feed origin = pick line center)

Name: rOrgY
Comment: Belt CS origin Y in world/MCS [mm]

Name: rOrgZ
Comment: Belt CS origin Z in world/MCS [mm] = rZBelt

Name: rPhi
Comment: Belt CS rotation in world [deg], x-axis along belt travel

Name: rZBelt
Comment: Belt surface height in world [mm] (item Z reference)

Name: ConveyorDistance
Comment: Sync-in conveyor distance [mm], must be > 0 (FW 2026.6: 0 => error 9006)

Name: bSingleType
Comment: Tool holds one type per cycle (no mixing)

Name: auiCupFbkCh
Comment: Per-cup vacuum feedback channels (0 = tool fbk) 1..GC_CUPS

Name: rCapCog
Comment: Max CoG offset from TCP [mm], 0 = check off

Name: abCupFbk
Comment: Per-cup vacuum feedback at grip end 1..GC_CUPS

Name: uiCupOk
Comment: Cups confirmed holding at the last sync grip

Name: rAppDx
Comment: Approach: X offset from pick/place point

Name: abiCamOwner
Comment: TRUE = this robot owns camera i 1..GC_CAMS

Name: iIdx
Comment: Queue index in the pick feed

Name: iIdxPlace
Comment: Queue index of the target in the place feed

Name: stTgt
Comment: v1.4 placement target snapshot (belt capture data driving the native tracked place)

Name: stSyncPick
Comment: Cluster TCP pose at the pick event (SyncAll)

Name: bDryRun
Comment: Trial run lock: no grip, raised Z

Name: uiCurPlaceFeed
Comment: Place feed of the current job (0 = none; R-05b collision input)

Name: bTrkPlace
Comment: v1.4: TRUE = native tracked place armed for the current place item

Name: uiToolMask
Comment: Bit i-1 = tool i idle (balancer input)
